# Voicemod triggers

## Background effects toggled

Runs when the background sound effects in Voicemod are turned on or off.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **State** | Choose On to react only when it is turned on, Off only when it is turned off, or Any for both. Options: Either way, Turned on, Turned off. Starts as: `Either way`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%enabled%` | True when background effects are on now |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.backgroundEffectsToggled`</small>

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to the Voicemod app (the voice changer program on your computer).

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%port%` | The port Voicemod answered on (you can ignore this) |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses the connection to Voicemod, for example when you close it.

<small>Type id: `voicemod.disconnected`</small>

## Hear myself toggled

Runs when 'hear my voice' (listening to yourself through your headphones) is turned on or off in Voicemod.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **State** | Choose On to react only when it is turned on, Off only when it is turned off, or Any for both. Options: Either way, Turned on, Turned off. Starts as: `Either way`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%enabled%` | True when hearing yourself is on now |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.hearMyselfToggled`</small>

## Microphone mute toggled

Runs when your microphone is muted or unmuted in Voicemod.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Muted** | Choose On to react only when the mic gets muted, Off only when it gets unmuted, or Any for both. Options: Either way, Muted, Unmuted. Starts as: `Either way`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%muted%` | True when the microphone is muted now |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.muteToggled`</small>

## Soundboard changed

Runs when Voicemod's soundboard changes, for example when you pick another soundboard or the list of sounds updates.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%soundboard.name%` | The name of the active soundboard |
| `%soundboard.id%` | The ID of the active soundboard |
| `%soundCount%` | How many sounds were loaded (only sometimes given) |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.soundboardChanged`</small>

## Voice changed

Runs when you switch to a different Voicemod voice, whether in Voicemod itself or from Cuebot.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Voices** | Only react when this voice was chosen, by its name as Voicemod shows it, like "Robot". Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any voice. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%voiceName%` | The name of the new voice |
| `%voiceId%` | The new voice's ID |
| `%previousVoiceName%` | The name of the voice before |
| `%previousVoiceId%` | The ID of the voice before |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.voiceChanged`</small>

## Voice changer toggled

Runs when the voice changer is turned on or off in Voicemod.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **State** | Choose On to react only when it is turned on, Off only when it is turned off, or Any for both. Options: Either way, Turned on, Turned off. Starts as: `Either way`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%enabled%` | True when the voice changer is on now |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.voiceChangerToggled`</small>
